task.name: put_doll_pink_plate_stapler_purple_plate_ep1
task.description: Use the left arm to put the doll into the pink plate, and use the right arm to put the blue stapler into the purple plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the yellow doll.
2. Grasp the yellow doll with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the pink plate.
4. Release the gripper to place the yellow doll into the pink plate.
5. Move the right arm to approach and align with the blue stapler.
6. Grasp the blue stapler with the right arm.
7. Move the right arm to align with the purple plate.
8. Release the gripper to place the blue stapler into the purple plate.
